java.title: Java Full Stack Developer
java.description: Go from Java fundamentals to shipping full-stack apps with Spring Boot, REST APIs and a React frontend.

topics.title: Core Java Fundamentals
topics.description: Start with java basics: Syntax, variables, data types, Type Casting, operators, Control flow and loops. This build a strong foundation for advanced topics.

topics.title: Strings, Arrays, Functions
topics.description:
String Concepts: Learn strings and their methods to store, manipulate, and process text data.
Arrays and Array methods: Learn 1D and 2D arrays and their methods.Store, access, and manipulate data efficiently. Functions: Create and use functions effectively.

topics.title: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
topics.description: OOPS CONCEPTS: Classes, Objects, Constructer, Encapsulation, Inheritance ,Polymorphism  and Abstraction — the four pillars. Explore Interfaces, Static and Super Keyword and Access Modifiers

topics.title: Collections Framework
topics.description: Learn Lists, Sets, Maps, and other collection classes. Understanding collections is crucial for writing efficient Java programs.

topics.title: Exception Handling
topics.description: Checked vs unchecked exceptions, Master try-catch blocks, throws, custom exceptions, exception handling best practices. Critical for writing robust code.

topics.title: File Handling
topics.description: Learn file creation, reading, writing, and updating data using Java file handling classes and streams.

topics.title: Data Structures & Algorithms
topics.description: Arrays, trees, graphs, sorting and searching — the problem-solving toolkit interviewers test.

topics.title: Memory Management
topics.description: Learn JVM memory management, heap and stack memory, garbage collection, and object lifecycle in Java.

topics.title: Java 8+ Features (Lambdas, Streams)
topics.description: Learn modern Java features: Lambda expressions, Streams, Functional Interfaces, Optional, and Date-Time API. Essential for modern Java development.

topics.title: Multithreading
topics.description: Learn about Threads, Synchronization, Executors, and Concurrent Collections. Required for scalable and performant apps.

topics.title: JSP, Servlet & Tomcat Setup
topics.description: Learn how to build web applications using Java Server Pages (JSP) and Servlets. Set up Apache Tomcat for local development and deployment.

topics.title: JDBC & Database Connectivity
topics.description: Learn how to connect Java applications to databases using JDBC. Practice CRUD operations and understand connection pooling.

topics.title: SQL & Database
topics.description: Learn SQL basics and database design. Practice queries and normalization. This step is essential for backend development.

topics.title: Build Tools (Maven/Gradle)
topics.description: Learn how to manage dependencies and build projects using Maven or Gradle. This step comes after you understand how to work with databases and web apps.

topics.title: Git & GitHub
topics.description: Version control workflows: branching, merging, pull requests and resolving conflicts.

topics.title: HTML
topics.description: Semantic markup and document structure for the pages your backend will serve.

topics.title: CSS
topics.description: Layout with Flexbox and Grid, responsive design and styling fundamentals.

topics.title: JavaScript
topics.description: Core language features, the DOM, and asynchronous programming with promises.

topics.title: React
topics.description: Components, props, state and hooks for building the frontend that talks to your API.

topics.title: Spring Boot - Main Framework for Java Development
topics.description: Learn to build modern Java applications with Spring Boot. Understand auto-configuration, dependency injection, REST APIs, and microservices.

topics.title: ORM (JPA/Hibernate)
topics.description: After mastering Spring Boot, learn Object-Relational Mapping with JPA and Hibernate. Map Java objects to database tables, perform CRUD operations, and optimize queries within Spring Boot apps.

topics.title: Spring Security
topics.description: Secure your Java applications using Spring Security. Learn authentication, authorization, JWT, OAuth2, and best practices for protecting APIs. This step builds on Spring Boot and ORM knowledge.

topics.title: Spring AI
topics.description: Explore AI integrations in Java using Spring AI. Learn to connect with LLMs, ML APIs, and build intelligent features into your Spring Boot apps. This is an advanced step after Spring Boot, ORM, and Security.

topics.title: Testing (JUnit & Mockito)
topics.description: Writing unit tests and mocking dependencies to ensure code quality. Testing is a must for professional development.

topics.title: Microservices Architecture
topics.description: Microservices Architecture

topics.title: Coding Profiles & Visibility
topics.description: Build your coding profiles (LeetCode, CodeChef, HackerRank, GitHub) and showcase your projects. Participate in contests, open source, and share your journey on LinkedIn.

topics.title: Deployment & Cloud (Docker/Cloud)
topics.description: Containerization with Docker and deploying applications to the cloud. Learn how to make your apps production-ready.

topics.title: Real-Life Project & Industry Preparation
topics.description: Build a real-life project (E-commerce, Blog, Chat App, etc.) and prepare for interviews. Apply all concepts, document your journey, and share on LinkedIn. This step is crucial for both freshers and experienced candidates.

topics.title: Interview Preparation
topics.description: Common Java and Spring interview questions, system design basics and mock rounds.

topics.title: Django / FastAPI

topics.title: REST APIs
